NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ekifo kyo kikozesebwa okubala obulungi ebiseera by’esswala eby’ekifo w’oli. Ekifo kyo kisigala ku kyuma kyo.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Ekifo kyo kikozesebwa okubala obulungi ebiseera by’esswala eby’ekifo w’oli, era, “Ndi ku muzikiti” bw’eba eri ku, okuteekako Engeri y’esswala bw’oyingira omuzikiti. Ekifo kyo kisigala ku kyuma kyo.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Ekifo kyo kikozesebwa okuzza obuggya ebiseera by’esswala byokka bw’okyusa ekibuga, era, “Ndi ku muzikiti” bw’eba eri ku, okuteekako Engeri y’esswala bw’oyingira omuzikiti. Ekifo kyo kisigala ku kyuma kyo.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Kamera yo ekozesebwa okulaga oluuyi lwa Kibula ku kifaananyi kya kamera n’okusoma koodi y’okugatta eri ku TV yo. Ebifaananyi tebiterekebwa era tebiva ku kyuma kyo.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Olukusa lwa kalenda lukozesebwa okugatta ebiseera by’esswala ku kalenda yo, era, bw’okiteekako, okukebera oba emikolo mu kalenda yo gibikka ekiseera ky’esswala. Ebikwata ku kalenda yo bisigala ku kyuma kyo.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Olukusa lwa kalenda lukozesebwa okugatta ebiseera by’esswala ku kalenda yo, era, bw’okiteekako, okukebera oba emikolo mu kalenda yo gibikka ekiseera ky’esswala. Ebikwata ku kalenda yo bisigala ku kyuma kyo.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: App eyunga ku TV eri ku mukutu gwo ogw’omu kitundu okugisindikira ebiseera byo eby’esswala n’esswala z’oteeseeko akabonero. Ebikwatako bikuumiddwa n’ekyama era bitambula wakati w’ebyuma ebyo byombi byokka.
NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Emitendera gy’ebijjukizo gy’olondera “Alaamu entuufu” giteekebwawo nga alaamu, n’olwekyo ogiwulira ne bw’oba nga essimu yo esirisiddwa oba nga Focus eri ku.
